gaps.term: applying the explicit network's eta bound to the shear
gaps.quote: For the explicit network the paper computes $\eta>20\cdot2^{-50}$ (cited)
gaps.note: The cited eta bound is for the paper's explicit network, but the page never says that this is the bit network carrying the shear, or how its W_b and s_b values determine eta. The reader cannot see why the cited result applies where it is used.

gaps.quote: The outer two cost linear time.
gaps.note: The page does not say linear in what, nor why subtracting u-bit fields over the whole array takes that time. The reader needs this cost to be absorbed into O(V u^tau) and cannot check it.

gaps.quote: Splitting, merging and gates are a fixed number of linear passes
gaps.note: Splitting and merging are named as operations of the recursion but neither explained nor linked on this page, so the reader cannot tell what is being counted as a fixed number of linear passes.

gaps.quote: A forward, inverse, forward schedule of these invocations exchanges the two banks
